items: 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved or quartered
Sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Make the dressing: whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, vinegar, shallot, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper. Set aside.
Prep the lettuce: cut the iceberg lettuce in half through the core, remove the core, and slice lengthwise into 1/4-inch strips. Repeat with the radicchio.
Assemble: in a large bowl, combine lettuce, radicchio, tomatoes, chickpeas, mozzarella, provolone, and pepperoncini.
Dress: drizzle with the dressing and toss gently to coat. Season with salt and pepper and toss again.
Garnish with extra oregano and serve.
